questions.q: What fundamentally sets ArduPilot apart from Betaflight?
options: It knows its position and flies by itself
It is meant for planes only
questions.explain: An autopilot: it knows its position, runs missions, flies without a pilot. Betaflight is a stabilizer for stick input.

questions.q: Does ArduPilot have a save command?
questions.explain: Some parameters require a reboot, but the write happens instantly.
Position modes need a healthy position estimate.

options: What is not ready for arming
questions.explain: Disabling pre-arm checks (ARMING_SKIPCHK, before 4.7 — ARMING_CHECK) to take off is the road to a crash.

questions.q: Why don't Lua scripts work on F4?
questions.explain: They need at least 2 MB of flash and memory that the F4 doesn't have.

questions.q: The ArduCopter counterpart of Betaflight Angle:
questions.explain: Stabilize stabilizes the angles but does not hold altitude.
